samples.question: The gold-framed mosaic is the source. Cyan cells are walls and cream cells are empty. Starting from a cream cell, you may move up, down, left, or right through cream cells; diagonal moves do not count. The result keeps every source cyan cell cyan and changes to cyan exactly those cream cells that cannot reach any outer edge of the source. Which red, green, or blue frame marks the exact result?
